temporal_density.static_hold_policy: avoid long single-still holds; every held key image must contain localized/internal motion and/or camera/depth evolution
temporal_density.keyframe_density_target: multiple meaningful visual states per second in active passages
temporal_density.video_insert_policy: author short rendered/conventional-video inserts at major musical and narrative transitions
temporal_density.intermediate_frame_policy: create in-between states and interpolation only as support for real authored motion; interpolation is not a substitute for shot design

visual_reference_content_reuse.rule: supplied stills may teach character/style/lighting/composition but may not be inserted into final picture until current user explicitly authorizes content reuse
